# Module: `icescopy_frame_source`

A shared frame interface for images, video, and ordered video clips.

[Source](../src/icescopy_frame_source.py) · [API index](API-Reference.md)

Display, analysis, and navigation ask a `FrameSource` for frame names, keys, pixels, and timing. Video uses PyAV and can retain a decoder plus a temporary PNG preview cache. Source payloads reference original media; session files do not embed it. A video sequence maps a global frame index to a clip and local index.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`VideoFrameMetadata`](API-Class-VideoFrameMetadata.md) | A video frame’s index, presentation timestamp, and time in seconds. |
| [`FrameSource`](API-Class-FrameSource.md) | The common interface consumed by frame display, navigation, and grayscale analysis. |
| [`ImageSequenceFrameSource`](API-Class-ImageSequenceFrameSource.md) | Reads individual image files and exposes their order as frames. |
| [`VideoFrameSource`](API-Class-VideoFrameSource.md) | Decodes a single video, exposes frame metadata, and manages video preview caching. |
| [`VideoSequenceFrameSource`](API-Class-VideoSequenceFrameSource.md) | Presents several ordered video clips as one frame sequence. |
